procedure: Pages rendered with pdfplumber page.to_image(resolution=220-300); the PORTRAIT sheet's rotated landscape table reads upright after PIL ROTATE_270 (cache/2026-scan-assessment/six/verify/benton_*). Every row's cell sum equals its printed TOTAL exactly (19/19).
structure_note: Two supply pages, one table: p1 is the certification/signature page; p2 carries the five precincts + TOTAL from U.S. Senate through Chancery Court 18-Chancery District 18 Place 1 (Jenessa Carter Hicks, Sarah J. Liddy -- the page ends there, with no Place 2 header); p3 continues the table over the same five precincts + TOTAL: Chancery 18 Place 2's rows (Jennifer L. Shackelford, Michael Watts), then Circuit 3's Places, then the local School Board 5 section. NOTE the printed-sheet quirk this continuation exposes: on p3 every section header box prints ONE ROW BLOCK LATE -- Shackelford/Watts print above the 'Chancery Court 18-... Place 2' box (it is their section), Bob Whitwell above the 'Circuit Court 3-... Place 1' box, Gray Tollison above the 'Place 2' box, and the 'Place 3' box prints mid-block between Steven Patrick Jubera and Kent E. Smith. Read with the boxes as printed, Benton's sheet pairs Circuit D3 as Place 1 = Bob Whitwell, Place 2 = Gray Tollison, Place 3 = Bart M. Adams + Shirley C. Byers + Steven Patrick Jubera + Kent E. Smith. Races: U.S. Senate; US House Of Rep 01-1st Congressional District; Court Of Appeals 01-District 1 Position 1 (Derek Dewayne Hopson Jr., John Weddle) and Position 2 (Donna M. Barnes); Chancery Court 18-Chancery District 18 Place 1 (Jenessa Carter Hicks, Sarah J. Liddy) and Place 2 (Jennifer L. Shackelford, Michael Watts); Circuit Court 3-Circuit District 03 Places 1/2/3 (Bob Whitwell; Gray Tollison; Bart M. Adams, Shirley C. Byers, Steven Patrick Jubera, Kent E. Smith). Printed totals: Colom 1265, Hyde-Smith 1493, Pinkins 64, Baucom 31, Cliff Johnson 1217, Kelly 1564, Hopson 1256, Weddle 1103, D. Barnes 2100, Hicks 480, Liddy 689, Shackelford 832, Watts 543, Whitwell 2152, Tollison 2116, Adams 1430, Byers 945, Jubera 157, Smith 2149.
operator_rows_note: All 19 in-scope rows supplied by operator_rows (identity from the printed ballot; cells keyed to p2/p3's manifest label order; position 5 is each page's printed TOTAL). Every row's cell sum equals its printed TOTAL exactly; both pages' printed TOTAL column is supplied where the sheet prints the row on both pages.
truncation_note: No truncations; the five precinct headers print complete and match the county's 2024 general spellings ('Floyd Precinct Dist 4' and 'Hickory Flat Prec Dist 5' are the sheet's own inconsistent abbreviations, confirmed at 300 dpi).
local_note: p3 ends with the local 'School Board 5-SCHOOL BOARD MEMBER DIST 5' section (Tracy Clayton); out of scope, and on an operator-supply page it contributes no parse rows. Circuit D3 roster divergence vs Union (advisory roster_subset at the family level): Union's recap prints Circuit D3 as Place 1 = Gray Tollison, Place 2 = (Adams, Byers, Jubera), Place 3 = Kent E. Smith, with no Whitwell section; Benton's own sheet pairs them as recorded above. Both counties' pairings are kept per-county as printed (source-fidelity convention); the family roster differs only by Union lacking Whitwell, so the cross-county roster gate records a roster_subset, not a mismatch.
